function.name: edit_file
function.description: Edits a file by replacing an existing string (old_str) (be specific with the string you want to replace) with a new one (new_str)

file_name.description: Relative file path from the current working directory to edit

old_str.description: Exact string to be replaced with new_str

new_str.description: New string to be written in the place of old_str
